fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the account was opened/operated from.

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the account.

fields.name: ACCOUNT/CONTRACT NUMBER
fields.description: Unique account identifier as assigned to customers' accounts by the reporting institution.

fields.name: ACCOUNT NAME
fields.description: Customer's First Name, Middle Name and Sir Name or registered company Name or Business/Trading Name.

fields.name: ACCOUNT OWNERSHIP TYPE
fields.description: Individual, joint, sole proprietor, partnership, corporate, group owned or a trust

fields.name: BUSINESS ECONOMIC ACTIVITY CODE
fields.description: As per ISIC with Agriculture being classified further into small and large scale enterprises, Agricultural boards and Cooperative Societies.

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: TYPE OF ACCOUNT
fields.description: e.g. Current A/c, Savings A/c, Transactional A/c, Loan A/c, Nostro A/c, Vostro A/c, etc.

fields.name: PRODUCT TYPE
fields.description: The type of product for the account.

fields.name: CHART OF ACCOUNTS CORRESPONDING CODE
fields.description: Corresponding chart of account class code for Assets, liabilities, capital, income, expense or off-Balance Sheet as per EDW chart of accounts.

fields.name: GL MAPPING CODE
fields.description: A GL code corresponding to the reporting line in the GL Mapping code list.

fields.name: DATE ACCOUNT WAS OPENED
fields.description: The date when the account was opened. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY} as per ISO 8601

fields.name: DATE ACCOUNT WAS CLOSED
fields.description: If applicable, else left blank. Format {DD-MMM-YYYY} as per ISO 8601

fields.name: DEBIT INTEREST RATE (DR)
fields.description: Interest rate for debits. Zero if not applicable

fields.name: CREDIT INTEREST RATE (CR)
fields.description: Interest rate for credits. Zero if not applicable

fields.name: ANTICIPATED MATURITY PERIOD
fields.description: The anticipated maturity period. E.g. Matured, 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-180 days, 6-9 months, 10-12 months, 1-3 years, 3-5 years and over 5 years.

fields.name: SANCTIONED ACCOUNT LIMIT IN FCY
fields.description: The approved/sanctioned maximum account limit amount in foreign currency, either debit or credit. E.g. 1,000,000 for an overdfraft whose maximum limit is 1 million in debit.

fields.name: SANCTIONED ACCOUNT LIMIT IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: The approved/sanctioned maximum account limit amount in local currency (LCY) equivalent, either debit or credit. E.g. 1,000,000 for an overdfraft whose maximum limit is 1 million in debit.
fields.payload_key: SANCTIONED ACCOUNT LIMIT IN LCY EQUIVALENT

fields.name: ACCOUNT STATUS
fields.description: e.g. Active, Inactive, Dormant and Closed.

fields.name: ACCOUNT STATUS CHANGE DATE
fields.description: Date when account status was last modified.

fields.name: EXPIRY DATE
fields.description: For overdraft facilities, else left blank.
